news.headline: Crude Oil WTI -1.95% to $90.06; Brent -1.69% to $102.95
news.what_happened: WTI and Brent fell nearly 2% in the last session, though both remain at elevated levels.
news.why_it_matters: Lower crude eases input costs for airlines (jet fuel) and paints (crude derivatives); negative for upstream oil realisations.

news.headline: US equities close higher: S&P 500 +0.59%, Nasdaq +0.64%
news.what_happened: S&P 500 ended at 7,811.54 and Nasdaq at 27,366.17 on Friday's close.
news.why_it_matters: Mild risk-on global cue; supports FII sentiment toward large caps, but US 10Y yield at 5.24% (+0.25%) is a headwind for EM flows.

news.headline: Nifty 50 closed at 22,520 (+1.3%) on Friday after a sharp rebound
news.what_happened: Nifty rebounded from 22,232 to 22,520 in the previous session. Hang Seng +0.54%, Nikkei flat.
news.why_it_matters: After a strong up-day, gap-ups may already price in upside; avoid chasing at the open.

news.headline: Gold +0.49% to $4,237; Silver +0.83%
news.why_it_matters: Mild defensive bid; supportive for gold-loan NBFCs, but not a strong risk-off signal.
